page.overview:
Who is Pietra?

Pietra is a character created by Matt Moylan and Genzoman who appeared originally in UDON Street Fighter Masters: Blanka Free Comic Book Day published in May 2022. Since then, she has appeared in UDON’s Street Fighter Swimsuit Special 2023, Street Fighter Swimsuit Special Collection (2024) and Street Fighter World Warrior Encyclopedia - World Tour Edition (2024).

Street Fighter World Warrior Encyclopedia - World Tour Edition reveals her full name is Pietra Oyarzo-Ayala.
